title: Kilcarbery Square , Kilcarbery Grange , Clondalkin, Co. Dublin
seoTitle: Kilcarbery Square , Kilcarbery Grange , Clondalkin, Co. Dublin
description:
MD Living is proud to introduce Kilcarbery Square, a brand-new development consisting of One, Two- and Three-Bedroom Homes. Kilcarbery Square overlooks Corkagh Park, which is one of Ireland's largest parks in which local residents are spoilt for choice as there is something for the whole family to enjoy. Jogging, golfing, or even playing baseball are all but a stone throw away from Kilcarbury Square as both Corkagh Park and Grange Castle Golf Club are a few minutes walk away.

This prestigious development also benefits from being located adjacent to the historic villages of Clondalkin & Lucan. The surroundings environs offer a range of amenities ranging from sporting pursuits such as GAA, golf and rugby, as well as the Clondalkin Leisure Centre and a wide range of cafes and restaurants. The main entrance to Kilcarbery Square opens directly onto the Outer Ring Road, linking the development with the M7, M4 and M50 in minutes, thus providing residents with ease of access to the rest of the country.
 
Local transport links include the excellent train service at both Clondalkin/Fonthill or Adamstown train stations and the LUAS Red Line at The Red Cow, each of which have superb park and ride facilities. Dublin bus operates a frequent service close by with numerous bus routes connecting commuters to the surrounding areas, city centre, The Docklands and beyond.
 
Development Features: 
 
Kilcarbery Square is located within the overall Kilcarbery Grange development, it is a brand-new community which will include a new civic square, a community building, a crèche, an exciting local retail space and importantly, it will also feature an abundance of open green space and a playground for all residents to enjoy.
